basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old manga enthusiast based in Seattle, WA. By day, I work as a software developer, crafting innovative solutions for tech startups. By night, I'm diving deep into manga and anime lore, with a particular fondness for 'Bleach' and the philosophical themes it explores. I believe in the power of storytelling to connect and inspire. When I'm not coding or reading manga, I enjoy exploring theological discussions, particularly around the concept of universalism. I'm married, and my partner shares my passion for storytelling. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings and during my lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My passion for manga began in college, where I spent countless hours analyzing the storylines and character arcs of my favorite series. I've also taken courses in philosophy and theology, which fuel my interest in subreddits like 'ChristianUniversalism'.
